It is an exact replica of the NYC era version and features 2N5088 transistors. The kit includes metal film resistors and metallized polyester film capacitors, which deliver vintage tone with reduced noise compared to the original. Despite its small size, the Li’l Beaver uses all through-hole components and panel mounted hardware. It also has true bypass functionality. The Li’l Beaver comes in various versions, each with its own unique characteristics. These versions include the Standard, the Deluxe, and the Ultra. The Standard version is the basic model and faithfully recreates the original Big Muff Pi sound. The Deluxe version adds additional controls for tone shaping, allowing for more versatility in shaping your sound. The Ultra version takes it a step further with even more control options, including a midrange control and a switch for selecting between different clipping diodes.
